title: ‘Tried To Cut Off His Penis’: Report Suggests Perez Hilton’s Injuries Require Extensive Care
text:
Photo by Denise Truscello/Getty Images

Perez Hilton reportedly attempted to sever his genitals during a self-harm livestream Aug. 4, according to Radar.

“Perez tried to cut off his penis,” a source reportedly told the outlet.

“This wasn’t a superficial injury. This was an incredibly serious attempt to mutilate himself.”

LAS VEGAS, NEVADA - NOVEMBER 08: Perez Hilton arrives at BOA Steakhouse grand opening at Grand Canal Shoppes at Venetian Las Vegas on November 08, 2025 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Denise Truscello/Getty Images for BOA Steakhouse Las Vegas)

The self-mutilation episode was severe, and his injuries were so serious that it remains unclear whether they will yield permanent and irreversible damage, reported Radar.

“His body went through enormous trauma,” the insider added.

“Doctors had to deal with the blood loss, the wounds, the broken bones, and all the other physical injuries before anything else. There were multiple medical issues happening at once.”

Celebrity Blogger Perez Hilton Hospitalized After Attempted Livestreamed Suicide

WESTCHESTER, FLORIDA - AUGUST 05: Miami-Dade County Sheriff’s deputies visit the home where Perez Hilton was found after he appeared to harm himself during a TikTok livestream on August 05, 2026, in Westchester, Florida. Perez Hilton was hospitalized on August 4 after deputies with the Miami-Dade County Sheriff’s Office were dispatched to the home. He was transported to a nearby hospital for medical attention. (Photo by Joe Raedle/Getty Images)

The source went on to say, “Keeping Perez alive, stable, and physically safe was the immediate priority.”

The report stated that Hilton was “disfigured” and his three children, who were in the home at the time of his apparent mental breakdown, were kept away from him for several weeks in an effort to protect them from further trauma.

“He’s still covered with cuts that are healing, stitches are dissolving, and he’s still got some on his face,” the source told Radar. (RELATED: Disturbing Details Emerge After Perez Hilton’s Self-Harm Livestream)

A post shared by 🧿 Perez Hilton 🧿 (@theperezhilton)

48-year-old Perez was rushed to a Miami-area hospital after appearing to shred and slice his skin with a knife while livestreaming, Aug. 4.

His family previously reported that he also suffered broken bones after several significant falls on the night of the tragic incident.
